_comment: Parcel screen for a West Austin wellness hotel site.
LAYER URLS ARE UNVERIFIED. They could not be reached from the build
environment, so they are best-known candidates. Run `screen_parcels.py
discover --config <this file>` once the network allows it, then paste the
real layer URLs into `layers` below. Discovery is the first step, not an
Everything else here — caps, rules, programme — is derived and documented

extent._comment: West Austin bounding box: roughly Lake Austin south to Oak Hill, downtown west to Bee Cave. WGS84.

parcels._verify: Travis County / TCAD parcel layer. Field names below MUST be checked against the layer's own field list before the first real run.

overlay._verify: Austin watershed regulation areas — the layer carrying Barton Springs Zone / Water Supply Suburban / Urban classifications.

ic_caps._comment: Impervious cover caps by overlay classification. Keys are matched case-insensitively against the overlay layer's name_field, so they must be edited to match that layer's actual values after discovery.

_improvement_note: Building area x this factor estimates SITE impervious cover (building + parking + drives). A screening heuristic only — the real figure comes from a survey, and it is the asset you would be buying.

rules._note: min_acres is 3 rather than 5 deliberately: a small parcel with high grandfathered cover is exactly the target, and the envelope test does the real filtering.

programme._comment: 50-key membership hotel-spa. Parking dominates, because a membership spa parks far more cars than 50 rooms do.
programme._parking_note: Set structured_parking true to re-run against a deck. The trade is resolved in the brief: a deck pays for itself inside the Barton Springs Zone. Running it both ways shows how many more parcels qualify.
